description:
Detects dangling CNAME records pointing to unclaimed external services enabling subdomain takeover

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_012", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%subdomain%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%takeover%') AND "value" > 0
